name: ui-skeleton-shimmer
title: Skeleton Shimmer
description: Thẻ khung xương xám đứng yên, một vệt sáng mềm nghiêng lướt ngang qua liên tục cho biết nội dung đang tải.

moworks.author: takayu

credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio skeleton-shimmer, written here): Skeleton card (dark #303b50, r7, overflow hidden) with an image block (27 % x 52 %) and two bars (7 px tall). Shimmer band 24 % of the card wide, full height, gradient transparent → white 36 % → transparent, blur 2 px, skewX −18°: translateX −160 % → +250 % of its width, opacity 0 → 0.75 (45 %) → 0, 1.2 s linear, repeating; clipped by the card. Params: band (24 % bề rộng thẻ) · skew (−18°) · duration (1.2 s / lượt) · peak (0.75) · ease (none). The band runs from −160 % to +250 % of its own width, clipped by the card.
moworks.titleVi: Khung xương tải có vệt sáng lướt
